verdict.rationale: incident.io documents two-way integrations across the named tools: Slack/Teams for declaring incidents and updates, GitHub/GitLab for connecting PRs and syncing follow-ups as Issues, Zoom/Teams for automatic call creation, Jira-style ticket sync (bidirectional incident/ticket updates), plus webhooks and a full REST API for custom bidirectional flows. Missing for 10: explicit named Jira integration details/dedicated doc page (only generic 'ticket' sync and integrations directory reference), and independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs of bidirectional sync reliability.
